text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: I ended up losing again, didn't I...?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
choice_data_list: H-How can you be laughing right now?
H-How can you be laughing right now?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Fufu, because I'm being tested, you see.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
They are likely watching to see if we can 
rise again even after being plunged into 
despair. That is what I believe.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
This string of defeats with no end in 
sight is itself a great trial. If that is 
the case...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Let us dare to smile—with the pride of a 
saint.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
To demonstrate that my spirit won't break 
under any trial, I must first show it 
through my posture.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Of course, it's impossible not to feel 
devastated. It pains me deeply that I 
couldn't achieve any results 
whatsoever..."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"However, even so, I will never succumb to 
despair. Never."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
For a saint is one who overcomes every 
trial!
choice_data_list: As expected of the saint, what a relief.

Then next time, let's overcome that 
despair. Absolutely!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
“It is true that I have put on a 
disgraceful display. I apologize for 
causing you concern.”

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
So as not to burden Trainer's heart any 
further, next time I will surely banish 
this great darkness!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Overcoming hardships and bringing 
light to the world is the duty of a saint.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Next time, I shall fulfill that mission!
